name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is a customer relationship management platform whose developer site documents APIs and apps.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Candidate credential families were enumerated from nine HubSpot developer-documentation pages (developers.hubspot.com) read on 2026-10-04, recorded as the sources cited by the family contracts; the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. Scanner rule artifacts (Gitleaks and TruffleHog sources, pinned to commits, read on 2026-10-04) were consulted only where the HubSpot pages state no format; they support one tool-corroborated consistency claim on the legacy API key family and one unresolved lead on private app tokens.
